properties.name: initial_delay
properties.comment: How long the pointer rests on a target before its tooltip shows (ToolTipSettings::initial_delay); negative throws std::invalid_argument.
hand: a view onto the window's ToolTipSettings::initial_delay; read_view and write_view go through require_access
